title: Prescribed Bottom-Head Legacy Authority and Poison-Surface Audit
scope: Bottom-boundary authority after an explicit soil-water request has been constructed. This is not a claim that all HeadCalc legacy globals are eliminated.

authority_audit.headcalc_behavior: HeadCalc initially copies legacy_swbotb to a local variable, then overwrites that local value from boundary_conditions%bottom_mode on the explicit state-binding path before bottom-boundary control flow.
authority_audit.required_test: Changing legacy swbotb after request construction must not change the mode-5 common-route candidate or bottom flux.

authority_audit.headcalc_behavior: Mode-5 head gradient reads state%hbot. The common route requires an explicit top provider, so the admitted top-boundary bridge returns without publishing/capturing legacy state.
authority_audit.required_test: Changing legacy hbot after request construction must not change the mode-5 common-route result.

authority_audit.headcalc_behavior: Mode 5 uses state%hbot for its lower gradient. state%gwlinp remains explicitly bound but does not replace the prescribed-head boundary condition.
authority_audit.required_test: Changing legacy gwlinp after request construction must not change the mode-5 common-route result.

authority_audit.explicit_authority: For prescribed-head mode the solved lower flux must be reconstructed after successful convergence from the same explicit continuity terms already used by HeadCalc: qtop, per-node storage change, source/sink provider values and root-sink provider values.
authority_audit.current_gap: state_binding%qbot is initialized from request%boundary%bottom_flux and mode-5 HeadCalc currently leaves it unchanged.
authority_audit.required_test: Both legacy qbot and request%boundary%bottom_flux must be independently poisonable without changing the solved prescribed-head bottom flux.

mode_specific_legacy_symbols.note: F-SI16 does not admit modes 1, 3, 8 or 9 and does not turn these symbols into common-request authority.

bridge_audit.provider_top_bridge: boundtop_state_bridge returns through evaluation_context%top_boundary on the admitted common route and therefore does not publish the explicit state into legacy globals.

minimal_safe_seam.location: HeadCalc successful-convergence block, before common-route result publication
minimal_safe_seam.guard: explicit state binding AND swbotb == 5 AND successful convergence
minimal_safe_seam.mechanism: Reuse the existing HeadCalc vertical-flux continuity recurrence already present for the swbotb==1 saturated special case. For the admitted swmacro==0 profile this recurrence uses only explicit grid geometry, candidate/base water content, state%qtop, fsi_ws%sink/source and root_sink_term.

source_evidence.supports: explicit mode override, provider authority, mode-5 gradient/residual, existing post-convergence continuity recurrence and explicit-provider bridge behavior
explicit bottom-head and current bottom-flux seed bindings
current request construction, validator and result publication
explicit drainage and subsurface-irrigation source/sink semantics
explicit qrot-style root-sink authority and arithmetic ordering
